crossRefs.note: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You…
David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees…
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor…
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made…
When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered…
When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you…
They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up and saw the Egyptians marching after them, and they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto Jehovah.
